name: scull7.com
description: Nathan Sculli resume site — Elm · Melange ports · glassmorphic galaxy · vim UX

scripts.dev: npm run melange && concurrently -k -n mel,vite -c magenta,cyan "npm run melange:watch" "npm run vite"
scripts.build: npm run melange && npm run vite -- build
scripts.inject:resume:dist: node _build/default/src/melange/crawlable/src/melange/crawlable_cli.cjs inject dist/index.html public/resume.json && node _build/default/src/melange/crawlable/src/melange/crawlable_cli.cjs write-md dist/index.md public/resume.json
scripts.opam:init: opam switch create . 5.2.0 -y --no-install && opam install . --deps-only -y && npm install
scripts.test:e2e: npm run melange && npm run e2e -- run
scripts.test:e2e:only: npm run melange && npm run e2e -- navigation
scripts.test:t13: npm run melange && npm run e2e -- t13
scripts.test:agentic: npm run melange && npm run e2e -- agentic
scripts.test:interview: npm run melange && npm run e2e -- interview
scripts.test: npm run elm:make && npm run test:t13 && SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:agentic && SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:e2e && SKIP_BUILD=1 npm run test:interview

author: Nathan Sculli <nathan@vegasbuckeye.com>
